product.introEn: Hôtel Moynat turns a silk square into a miniature archive of journeys. Inspired by the hotel stickers once attached to the house’s vintage trunks, the multicoloured print gives travel ephemera a place in a contemporary wardrobe. The 70 cm format keeps the composition compact, while hand-rolled edges provide a soft finish around its illustrated surface. Fold it narrowly to show a ribbon of colour, or leave a corner open to reveal more of the graphic story. It is a playful option for someone who enjoys accessories with a clear connection to luggage and travel history.
featuresEn: 70 × 70 cm silk square with hand-rolled edges
Multicoloured hotel-label motif inspired by Moynat’s vintage trunks
Part of the Hôtel Moynat limited-edition capsule; no numbered quantity is stated
product.stylingEn: Tie it loosely at the neck over an ivory shirt or navy knit so the multicoloured labels supply the accent. Fold it into a narrow band for a quieter treatment, or leave one broad corner visible to show the travel-inspired graphic.
product.designer: Hôtel Moynat capsule collaboration with Storm Pablo and Marvin Douglas
